$description: Closed asset-role registry. availability is the three-way contract (reference-only | generation-safe | blocked-for-generation). The same values are pinned in code (PINNED_AVAILABILITY in schema/semantic_validate.py and extraction/verify_all.py) so editing this file alone cannot loosen them.
generationRules: mode=generated: every media assetRole must be generation-safe AND listed in that section's generatedAssetRoles.
Never reproduce real logos (customers, investors, press outlets, partners), real people's photos or identities, the source wordmark or product lockups, source product UI, or source copy.
Generated media src must use generated://, placeholder:// or user-supplied:// schemes, or an https URL on a reserved .example / .invalid domain.
Generated links must be relative paths, fragments, or reserved .example / .invalid domains; mailto only to .example addresses.
